# E0353: an _each maps something other than an open list to an open list

each maps the elements of an open list, `[...T]`, in the source to an open list
in the target, element by element. A source field that is not a list has no
elements to map.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name: string
}
```

`ship/history/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	names: [...string]
}

ForwardLens: (prev): {
	self: {
		names: _each(prev.name, {
			item
		})
	}
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	names: [...string]
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0353]: _each maps a list to a list; v0.0's name and v1.0's names must both be lists
 --> history/1.0.thema:7:10
  |
7 |         names: _each(prev.name, {
  |                ^^^^^
  |
```
